horn: countdown remaining < 12 → PlaySoundBJ; first wave ≈ 12s after horn
siegeRule: ModuloInteger(GetTriggerExecCount(ZG), 7) == 0 → +1 siege per live lane (same ranged spawn loc)

upgrade.approxPerTier: melee +10 HP +1 atk; ranged +10 HP +2 atk (web approx); max ~30

superCreeps: Per-lane rax death clears flag (JI/KI/LI melee, WI/XI/YI ranged radiant; HI/ZI/VI, EI/FI/GI dire) → SPO swaps to e00V/e00W/e026 or u001/u002/u00R
withinWaveOrder: Same SPO tick: Dire 3 lanes melee → Dire ranged → Dire siege(if) → Radiant melee → Radiant ranged → Radiant siege(if). No Timer between CreateNUnitsAtLoc; melee/ranged appear same frame (engine may scatter by pathing).
why4or5Observed: Non-siege waves = 4; every 7th wave = 5. Partial deaths / block miss / super-swap do not change spawn count.
